svg.text: 02 Side drawer bay frames — build four
BED v7 | build order | exploded reference module; mirror/repeat as stated below
BEDROOM WORKSHOP | mm | verify stock and purchased hardware before cutting | revision 2026-11-15
1. Build rows 1 and 2, left and right. Match the IDs: these are mirrored cases.
2. Join full-width Head/Foot ends to Inner Side. Rear Base Brace stays behind the drawer.
3. Leave the floor under the drawer OPEN: the 1-inch wheels run on the room floor.
4. Fit short Guide strips; rout only the internal L recess. Keep outside end panels solid.
